prompt.v: A circle has radius 10 m, and a central angle of 72°. Give the exact arc length, in meters, as a multiple of π.
s
π

problems.explain: First the angle in radians: 72° × π/180 = 2π/5. s = rθ: s = 10 × 2π/5 = 4π. (Using 72 for θ without converting gives an arc far too big.) So s = 4π meters.
